purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Udaipur Development Authority publishes city property and planning services. The Rajasthan E-Mapping viewer uses khasra/village boundaries and displays Khasra ID, DLC rates and coordinates for a selected record; no selector was submitted and no parcel was clicked. Static UDA plan documents are planning/layout products, not a verified current parcel feature service. No safe geometry-only public route was verified.
registryAssessment: The official Udaipur Development Authority offers city-specific Property ID, property name-transfer, mutation, subdivision, and land-layout services. Rajasthan’s state E-Mapping portal shows urban khasra selection and explicitly exposes a Khasra ID and land-rate information, so it is not a safe geometry-only response. These sources establish city development/property administration, but not open parcel coverage at this point.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Udaipur Development Authority page lists Property ID Creation, Name Transfer, Online Mutation, Subdivision and Reconstitution, and other UDA property services.
Official UDA planning page lists master/zonal/layout and GIS zonal plan products and displays an informational-use acknowledgement; no acknowledgement was submitted.

Official Rajasthan E-Mapping page says it uses khasra/village boundaries and is viewing-only; its selected-khasra panel includes Khasra ID and DLC rate fields. No search was submitted or parcel selected.
Official Board of Revenue page documents cadastral-map digitization statewide; this is not by itself evidence of point coverage.
